record.title: Unavailability of Yandex Cloud zones
components: Yandex MPP Analytics Engine for PostgreSQL
Yandex Managed Service for Apache Airflow®

updates.body:
The Yandex Cloud platform is still operating in a limited mode. Our specialists continue restoration work around the clock. The technical support team receives an increased number of requests, so the response time can be increased.
Our recommendations continue to be relevant. We recommend using alternative sites for hosting and reserving resources.
The next update will be published on October 12 at 19:00 Moscow time.

As a result of the UAV attack, the infrastructure of Yandex’s data center in Vladimir was damaged. The data center’s operation has been completely suspended. There are no casualties; the relevant services are already on site and dealing with the consequences.
We consider the remaining resource configuration to be unstable. The platform’s operating mode is emergency — we recommend using any other alternative disaster recovery plans. Communication channels with technical support may be unstable. The Yandex Cloud team is working to restore service operations.

Service availability remains unchanged. We continue working around the clock to restore services and platform components.
Technical support channels have been partially restored. The Yandex Cloud platform team is working to process support requests faster, but responses may still be significantly delayed. As previously announced, quota increases for additional cloud resources remain suspended.
We will provide the next update on October 11 at 18:00 Moscow time (UTC+3).

The Yandex Cloud platform continues to operate with limited functionality. Our technical teams are restoring services, while our support team is handling requests around the clock. We continue to recommend considering alternative platforms to deploy your resources more quickly and provide redundancy.
We will provide the next update on October 12 at 11:00 Moscow time (UTC+3).

The Yandex Cloud platform is still operating in a limited mode. Our specialists continue restoration work around the clock. The technical support team receives an increased number of requests, so the response time can be increased.
Our recommendations continue to be relevant. We recommend using alternative sites for hosting and reserving resources.
The next update will be published on October 12 at 19:00 Moscow time.

The Yandex Cloud platform operates in a limited mode. Technical support receives an increased number of requests, so the response time can be increased.
We collected answers to the most common questions and recommendations for restoring work, which will help you navigate the available options.
The next update will be published on October 13 at 11:00 Moscow time.

The Yandex Cloud platform continues to operate in a limited capacity. Our engineers are continuing recovery efforts.
We understand that your teams are currently focused on restoring their services. To ensure you do not have to worry about additional cloud costs during this time, we have decided to make the use of all Yandex Cloud services across all availability zones in the Russian Federation free of charge for existing customers from October 8 through October 31, inclusive.
Your October invoice will reflect only the costs for resources used up to and including October 7.
Charges for the period starting October 8 may still appear in your billing account, but we will adjust them automatically. No action is required on your part.
We will publish the next update on October 13 at 19:00 Moscow time.

The status of the cloud platform remains unchanged; the Yandex Cloud team continues to restore services. We have updated the statuses and recommendations for specific services—we do this daily on a dedicated page.

The Yandex Cloud platform is still operating in a limited mode. Our specialists continue the restoration work around the clock. Recommendations for restoring services are updated daily on a separate page: https://yandex.cloud/en/recommendations

Yandex’s cloud platform continues to operate with limitations. Engineers are working around the clock to restore service functionality. We update all currently available product‑related recommendations on a daily basis.

The Yandex Cloud platform operates in a limited mode. Our specialists are carrying out restoration work.
Users can keep up-to-date information about the availability of individual services in the management console. We also regularly update recommendations for restoring services.

The current status of individual platform services:

  • Yandex Cloud Console and API are available;
  • Compute: partially available;
  • Managed Databases: the service is available, but difficulties persist with Managed Service for Apache Kafka®.
  • S3: available for reading and writing, with possible slowdown in operation speed.
  • Managed Service for Kubernetes: available, but issues with individual clusters may persist;
  • Yandex Monium is unavailable;
  • Yandex Container Registry is operational;
    • Yandex AI Studio: services are partially available, more details about the status.
    • Security services are partially available, more details about the status.

The operation of the technical support channels has been partially restored; we are working to speed up the processing of inquiries, but there may still be significant delays in responses. We have also temporarily suspended the issuance of quotas for additional cloud resources.

The next update will be released on October 11 at 13:00 Moscow time.

The team continues to work on restoring and stabilizing key services. We’re sharing an update on the service operations:

  • Yandex Cloud Console and API are available;
  • Compute: partially available;
  • MDB: most HA database clusters have switched over; some may operate in read‑only mode or be unavailable.
  • S3: available for reading, but there may be issues with writing;
  • Managed Service for Kubernetes: available, but issues with individual clusters may persist;
  • Yandex Monium: unavailable;
  • Yandex Container Registry: operational;
  • Yandex AI Studio: services are partially available, more details about the status.
  • Security services are partially available, more details about the status.

The Yandex Cloud team is working to resume the operation of technical support communication channels. The main recommendation remains the same: please use alternative platforms to restore resources.

Updates on the operation of services and components as of 07:13:

• Yandex Cloud Console and API are available;
• Compute: partially available;
• MDB: most HA database clusters have switched over; some may operate in read‑only mode or be unavailable.
• S3: available for reading, write issues may be observed.
• Managed Service for Kubernetes: partially available;
• Yandex Identity and Access Management (IAM) is available;
• Yandex Monium is unavailable.

The team is working on restoring technical support communication channels. We recommend using alternative sites to restore resources.

We are sharing the status of individual components and services as of 6:10:

• S3: available for reading, potential issues with writing;
• Managed Service for Kubernetes: we are assessing the status of regional clusters;
• Yandex Identity and Access Management (IAM) is available;
• Other services may experience disruptions – we will provide updates on their status later.

Communication channels with technical support may be unstable. Information on the status board appears with a delay. We recommend using alternative resource recovery plans on external platforms.
